terminal_state_categories.prepared_unrun: run was prepared but the model adapter was not completed
terminal_state_categories.terminal_operator_failure: adapter, budget, runtime, or operator failure has a terminal receipt
terminal_state_categories.executed_unchecked: adapter execution has a receipt but the isolated checker has no terminal result
terminal_state_categories.checked_fixture_nonexperimental: local fixture output is permanently ineligible
terminal_state_categories.integrity_failure: run directory or terminal evidence is unreadable, malformed, or hash-inconsistent
terminal_state_categories.checked: production checker completed; eligible only when result_eligible is literal true

reporting_boundary: The completion ledger is operator-visible missingness evidence, not a formalization outcome. Incomplete execution cannot yield the preregistered primary or secondary inferential results.
